ns2:section.sectionText: Dynamic system models and classical control concepts, design and analysis; mathematical background for modern control and systems; qualitative aspects of linear systems theory; frequency domain analysis of multivariable systems; quantitative aspects of linear systems theory; and optimal control system design.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Industrial Engr Online-UIUC, MS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, MS: Aerospace Engr-Online-UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or MENG:Mech Engineering Onl-UIUC.
